name: com.classicspins.pf-firebase-crashlytics
description: PrototypeFramework service module: Firebase Crashlytics in place of the framework's CrashLog boot node. The replacement keeps the node's id, capabilities and unhandled-exception hooks, then starts Crashlytics in the background without holding boot. Native crashes and uncaught C# exceptions (reported as fatal) reach the Crashlytics console. Without the Firebase Crashlytics SDK installed the start is refused and logged; nothing falls back.
